name: manual_b5a913
claim: Change a byte-identical cross-repo probe in lockstep: implement in one repo, copy the probe and re-pin the other, then re-pin back, and verify with cmp.

decisions.notes: Two repos pin each other's commits, so one probe change forces a three-step pin sequence.

rationale: Two repos pin each other's commits, so one probe change forces a three-step pin sequence.
